title: Witches Offering to Demon
description: Three green-skinned witches with blue floral headdresses and golden neck rings stand in profile at the edge of dark water, holding small white orbs in their outstretched hands. In the background, a horned demonic figure with purple lightning sits atop a throne of skulls and bones on a mound of dark earth, surrounded by glowing orbs and mystical symbols.
